system.description:
Deal [[/r 1d6 + @battle-status.power.attack.total]]{[(SR)D + (Attack Power)]}  physical damage to the target.

(Target: Post-Action): The target takes [Decay: 10].

(Target: Pre-Action): The target's [Initiative] becomes 0. This effect lasts until the end of the round.

A special skill that impedes action by striking the enemy's head, throat, etc. with a two-handed weapon. The effect is great if you aim at an enemy that is exposed.
